Definition: from G4680; wisdom (higher or lower, worldly or spiritual):--wisdom.
BiblicalUsage: Wisdom in the New Testament has two sources, and the letters keep them apart. If any lack wisdom, let him ask of God, who giveth liberally; Christ Jesus is made unto us wisdom, and in Him are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge; and the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, full of mercy and good fruits.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe true wisdom is not cleverness but a gift, and I hold that it is found in Christ and proved by a peaceable life. The wisdom from above is known by its fruit: pure, peaceable, and full of mercy.
